issues.description: Hero text overlaps the background image making it completely unreadable.
Body text has a contrast ratio below 4.5:1 against its light-grey background, failing WCAG AA.
The primary call-to-action button is clipped by the right edge of the viewport on mobile.
Card grid breaks into a single overflowing row on screens narrower than 480 px instead of stacking vertically.
The page heading uses font-size 96 px — far too large relative to body text, breaking visual hierarchy.
